Sheet rules: landscape FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS of EIGHT equal square cells in an exact regular 4×2 grid. One full dog per cell, all eight frames. Make each entire dog SMALL and spacious: about 60–65 percent of each square cell's width and height, with head diameter about 28 percent of cell width. Most canvas is empty transparent space. Grounded paws sit on the same invisible local foot baseline at 82 percent of each cell's height. Keep dog body centered; movement comes from genuine pose articulation. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, no contact/drop shadow, no checkerboard pixels, no black/white/colored backdrop, no text, frame numbers, labels, borders, grid lines, watermarks or motion graphics. DOG ONLY: no visible toy, ball, frisbee, bowl, hand, leash, food or any other object. The app draws a toy separately.
